"""Add a cover page titled 'Annual Financial Report' to report.pdf."""
from datetime import date
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.lib.units import inch
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

INPUT_PDF = "report.pdf"
OUTPUT_PDF = "report_with_cover.pdf"
COVER_PDF = "cover_page.pdf"

WIDTH, HEIGHT = letter
TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"
TODAY = date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")

# 1) Build the cover page with reportlab
c = canvas.Canvas(COVER_PDF, pagesize=letter)

c.setStrokeColorRGB(0.2, 0.3, 0.5)
c.setLineWidth(3)
c.line(1 * inch, HEIGHT - 1.5 * inch, WIDTH - 1 * inch, HEIGHT - 1.5 * inch)

c.setFillColorRGB(0.1, 0.1, 0.2)
c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 30)
c.drawCentredString(WIDTH / 2, HEIGHT / 2 + 0.4 * inch, TITLE)

c.setFont("Helvetica", 16)
c.drawCentredString(WIDTH / 2, HEIGHT / 2 - 0.4 * inch, "Annual Financial Report")

c.setFont("Helvetica", 14)
c.setFillColorRGB(0.3, 0.3, 0.3)
c.drawCentredString(WIDTH / 2, HEIGHT / 2 - 1.1 * inch, TODAY)

c.setStrokeColorRGB(0.2, 0.3, 0.5)
c.setLineWidth(3)
c.line(1 * inch, 1.5 * inch, WIDTH - 1 * inch, 1.5 * inch)

c.save()

# 2) Merge the cover page in front of report.pdf using pypdf
reader = PdfReader(INPUT_PDF)
cover = PdfReader(COVER_PDF)

writer = PdfWriter()
writer.add_page(cover.pages[0])
for page in reader.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)

with open(OUTPUT_PDF, "wb") as fh:
    writer.write(fh)

print(f"Created {OUTPUT_PDF} with {len(writer.pages)} pages "
      f"(1 cover + {len(reader.pages)} from report.pdf)")
print(f"Title: {TITLE}")
print(f"Date: {TODAY}")
PYEOF
